title: Preservation of the specified right internal-Hom evaluations
statement: For a twisted action-site Presentation P [def-sf-twisted-action-presentation-data], let U be its specified underlying-module functor. For source module sheaves M,N, let eB and eA be the right evaluations on Hom(M,N) tensor M and Hom(U(M),U(N)) tensor U(M), respectively, each satisfying its complete IsSheafEvaluation characterization [def-sf-ringed-forget-tensor-transposition-data]. Then P.tensor(Hom(M,N),M).hom followed by P.hom(M,N).hom tensor identity followed by eA equals U(eB). This is just the evaluation square for the specified components; no tensor coherence or naturality assertions are included.

proof.text: By right_evaluation_eq, each of the two maps characterized by IsSheafEvaluation is the corresponding braiding followed by the existing canonical left evaluationMap. Substitute both equalities and functoriality of U.

proof.text: Apply braiding naturality to move P.hom(M,N).hom through the target braiding. Apply P.symmetry to move the tensor comparison through the braiding. The desired equation is now the composite of U of the source braiding with the reverse of the specified P.evaluation equation.

lean.statement:
theorem specified_evaluation_square (P : Presentation J s R a) :
    letI := P.category
    let U := P.modules.functor ⋙ forgetPairs (sigma J s R a)
    ∀ (M N : Modules P.coefficient)
      (eB : tensorObj (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := P.coefficient) M N) M ⟶ N)
      (eA : tensorObj (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := R) (U.obj M) (U.obj N)) (U.obj M) ⟶
        U.obj N),
      RingedForgetTensorTransposition.IsSheafEvaluation.{u, u, u}
        P.topology P.coefficient M N eB →
      RingedForgetTensorTransposition.IsSheafEvaluation.{u, u, u}
        J R (U.obj M) (U.obj N) eA →
      (P.tensor (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := P.coefficient) M N) M).hom ≫
        tensorMap (P.hom M N).hom (𝟙 (U.obj M)) ≫ eA = U.map eB
